chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 536: The Grand Xia World-Suppressing Grand Formation Activates
chapter_meta_description: War escalates! A thousand Celestial Immortals fall to Bloodcloud golems. Real Immortal Baiji reveals terrifying power. The Xia Emperor activates a realm-wide formation to force the Seamless Gate’s hand.
og_title: The War Tips – Desolate Era Ch 536 Recap
og_description: Zhanghong falls, Baiji reveals his icy sun, and the Xia Emperor makes his move on a continental scale. The Seamless Gate is losing the tempo war.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 536: The Emperor Strikes Back
twitter_description: A thousand Celestial Immortals die in seconds. The Seamless Gate’s hidden ace appears. The Grand Xia’s true formation rises.

surfaces: Ten Thousand Thralls Come to Pay Court
lore_anchors.definition: A forbidden secret art of the ancient imperial clan, named after the ritual of a thousand vassal states paying homage. The Xia Emperor can only summon nine black dragons, each matching an Empyrean God golem, but a master could summon ten thousand.

A Ki Refiner who has mastered a pure Yang technique and completed the Primal-to-Earth-Immortal breakthrough. Real Immortal Baiji is revealed as one, making him the Seamless Gate’s most dangerous individual combatant on this field.

A continent-spanning array forged by Daofather Yinglong, using the Tianmang Hall as its core and all 3,600 commandery cities as nodes. Its activation signals the shift from skirmish warfare to total existential war.

A temporary divine being manifested by a war formation of Fiendgod soldiers. Each Xingtian is roughly comparable to an Empyrean God in combat power. Zhanghong was one of several such spirits active on the Grand Xia side.
A Xianxia concept representing a realm’s accumulated destiny or luck; losing it makes a world vulnerable to conquest, and protecting it is a strategic priority.
